title: A back on the ramp
logline: A man in plaid sitting on Gully's ramp from behind, the pup beside him, the dock and the bay ahead of them, Gully's boots on the planks at the edge. The first page the two men share, as a back and two boots.

panels.composition: A man in blue plaid sitting on a plank ramp from behind with a small three-legged dog beside him, the dock and bay ahead, a stocky man's work boots on the planks at the frame's edge.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a man in blue plaid flannel sitting on a plank ramp seen from behind with a small three-legged dog beside him and a dock and bay ahead, a stocky man's work boots at the frame's edge, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
